title: Your diagnostic
noData: Enter at least one month in My numbers to start your diagnostic.
reliableGap: Add more data in My numbers to get a reliable benchmark gap.
optimizeHelp: Your active levers compared with your niche benchmark.
extraClients: +{count} possible clients/month by fixing your {points} weakest points
withAverageBasket: Calculated with your actual average basket (no main offer defined)
withOfferAverage: Calculated with your average offer price ({price}). Define a main offer for an exact estimate.
noPrice: Estimate unavailable: no offer price entered
unpricedPoints: {count} point{plural} below benchmark, not priced yet
addHelp: Levers you are not using yet, ranked by potential.
followupUnmeasured: Not entered yet: how do you measure this?
followupHelp: Tell us whether you have a follow-up sequence in My business, Sales section.
simulationHelp: Projection with everything at benchmark at once, different from the sum above (improvements multiply one another).
notMeasured: Not measured yet. How do I measure this?
verdictSolid: Your measured rates are at benchmark level. Solid.
spotlightSummary: {current}% currently · benchmark {benchmark}% · {clients} potential client{plural} per month.
calculationExplanation: For each point below benchmark, I simulate your funnel with that rate brought up to the market level (the others stay real), then multiply the extra sales by your offer price. I only combine the first three points to keep the estimate credible.
unpricedHelp: Enter an offer price so I can convert these gaps into euros.
solidBubble: Your active levers are solid. Check Add to see what you can implement next.
adviceOne: My top advice: fix this first. It is your biggest lever.
benchmarkEstimate: Estimate: part of this funnel is not measured yet.

metricExplanations.responseRate: {current}% of your messages receive a reply. Your niche benchmark is {benchmark}%. Reaching it would give you {gain} more conversations per month.
metricExplanations.proposalRate: {current}% of your conversations lead to a call proposal. The benchmark is {benchmark}%. At that level, you propose {gain} more calls per month.
metricExplanations.bookingRate: {current}% of your proposed calls are booked. The benchmark is {benchmark}%. Reaching it would give you {gain} more booked calls per month.
metricExplanations.showUpRate: {noShow}% of your booked calls are no-shows. The benchmark is {benchmark}%. Bringing this up to standard gives you {gain} more attended calls per month.
metricExplanations.closingRate: {current}% of your attended calls become sales. The benchmark is {benchmark}%. Reaching it would give you {gain} more sales per month.
